mito -coverage cov.txt -dump always -data state.json src.cel
cmp stdout want.txt
cmp stderr want_err.txt
cmp cov.txt want_cov.txt

-- state.json --
{"n": 0}
-- src.cel --
{
	"has_x_y_z": has(state.?x.?y.z),
}
-- want.txt --
{
	"has_x_y_z": false
}
-- want_err.txt --
<input>:1:1
 | {
 | ^
{has_x_y_z: false}

<input>:2:2
 |  "has_x_y_z": has(state.?x.?y.z),
 | .^
has_x_y_z

<input>:2:18
 |  "has_x_y_z": has(state.?x.?y.z),
 | .................^
false
-- want_cov.txt --
1: 1.00 (1/1)
2: 0.14 (1/7) [3 5 6 7 8 9]
 |  "has_x_y_z": has(state.?x.?y.z),
 |  !                !    ! !! !
